date_selection: Twelve fixed mid-quarter dates in three preselected years, no engine or reference residual used to select an epoch.
alias_basis: NASA documents Mercury1=199 and Venus2=299; Mars/Jupiter/Saturn require system barycenters, never planet centers.
scope: New fixed-date Guolao integration holdout after prior development diagnostics. Reference rates are not used by production. Not an independent dynamics model, real-world outcome study, full date-domain or whole-original certification.
failure_policy: Keep every failed batch, missing probe and uncertainty. Unresolved reference evidence is not a pass. Preserve all original references, thresholds and failures.
candidate_policy: Report native and current delivered rates for every target, date and actual configured model; no epoch-specific corrections, residual fitting, threshold changes or omission of failed/uncertain rows.
